title: Neural-arch share of 2 kN compression by disc degeneration grade, erect (2 deg extension) and flexed
condition: intact FSUs after 2 h creep at 2 kN, grouped by disc degeneration grade (1 = non-degenerated)

quantity.name: neural-arch load share
quantity.definition: compressive force on the neural arch = 2 kN - force on the disc (integrated, calibrated stress profile), as % of 2 kN; mean +- SD per degeneration grade

source.authors: Pollintine P, Dolan P, Tobias JH, Adams MA
source.sample: 23 lumbar FSUs with pre- and post-creep profiles (of 33 tested from 25 cadaveric spines: 3 L1-L2, 12 L2-L3, 2 L3-L4, 15 L4-L5, 1 L5-S1); grade 1 n=6, grade 2 n=7, grade 3 n=4, grade 4 n=6
source.age: whole sample 19-82 (mean 50, SD 19); not given per grade

protocol.summary: FSUs in dental-stone cups on a hydraulic testing machine (rollers; no imposed axis; small horizontal settling allowed); disc midplane horizontal. 2-h creep at 2 kN, then 2 kN static compression for 20 s while a pressure transducer is pulled through the disc (stress profilometry), in 2 deg extension (erect standing) and 6-12 deg flexion (forward bending, depending on specimen mobility). Disc force from integrated vertical stress, calibrated per disc against the pre-creep neutral profile.
how_to_simulate: Model a lumbar FSU (L2-L3 or L4-L5) with a non-degenerated disc; reduce disc height/water as after 2 h of 2 kN creep if the model allows
Erect: rotate to 2 deg extension, then apply 2 kN compression normal to the disc midplane
Flexed: rotate to 6-12 deg flexion (end of compliant range), then apply 2 kN
Report force on the neural arch (2 kN - disc force) as % of 2 kN
protocol.notes: Card uses grade 1 (non-degenerated, n=6), as in the Ghezelbash 2020 review. Anterior/posterior vertebral-body shares (Table 1) and age trends (Figs 3-4) not extracted.

extraction.check_notes: Review values 8+/-6 (extension) and 2+/-3 (flexion) = grade 1 discs (n=6), after creep; confirmed. Review did not state the grade or n.
